_note: Own one-line descriptions of the EMBER2024 family-model outputs (no third-party text). type: what kind of malware / software it is; generic: an AV detection name, not a family; malpedia: the Malpedia id when verified (otherwise the app links a Malpedia search).

1clickdownload.about: Download manager that bundles adware offers.

2144flashplayer.about: Chinese "Flash player" installer that bundles adware.

4dots.about: Utility installers flagged for bundled offers.

7ev3n.about: 7ev3n ransomware, which also locks the system.

7zip.about: 7-Zip archiver; legitimate, often bundled or abused to unpack payloads.

888rat.about: 888 RAT, Windows/Android remote access trojan spread through cracked builds.

adaware.about: Adaware / Lavasoft software, flagged for bundled offers.

addlyrics.about: Adware that injects lyrics and ads into web pages.

adlice.about: Adlice security tools, sometimes flagged as hacktools.

adwind.about: Adwind / jRAT, cross-platform Java RAT sold as a service.

alien.about: Alien, Android banking trojan derived from Cerberus.

amadey.about: Amadey, botnet loader that drops stealers and other payloads.

andariel.about: Malware attributed to Andariel, a Lazarus sub-group (North Korea).

arrowrat.about: Arrow RAT, remote access with hidden desktop.

asyncrat.about: AsyncRAT, open-source .NET RAT widely used by criminals.

autojs.about: Auto.js Android automation framework, abused by malicious apps.

avbdiscsoft.about: Disc-imaging software installers flagged for bundled offers.

avgsecurebrowser.about: Bundled browser installer flagged as PUA.

azovwiper.about: Azov, destructive wiper posing as ransomware that also infects files.

babuk.about: Babuk ransomware; its leaked source is reused by many groups.

badiis.about: BadIIS, malicious IIS modules for SEO fraud and backdoor access.

badpack.about: Android packages with tampered headers to defeat analysis.

bahamut.about: Bahamut, mercenary group behind mobile surveillance apps.

bankcerberus.about: Cerberus, Android banking trojan sold as a service.

banload.about: Banload, Brazilian downloader for banking trojans.

baofeng.about: Chinese media player installer flagged for bundled offers.

basebridge.about: BaseBridge, early Android trojan with premium-SMS fraud.

bedep.about: Bedep, ad-fraud downloader spread by exploit kits.

blackenergy.about: BlackEnergy, modular malware used against Ukraine's power grid.

boratrat.about: Borat RAT, .NET RAT with ransomware and DDoS features.

carberp.about: Carberp, banking trojan whose source leaked in 2013.

cerberus.about: Cerberus, Android banking trojan sold as a service.

certify.about: Certify, Active Directory Certificate Services abuse tool.

chir.about: Chir, mass-mailing worm and file infector.

clipbanker.about: ClipBanker, clipboard hijacker that swaps crypto-wallet addresses.

cobaltstrike.about: Cobalt Strike, commercial red-team framework widely abused by attackers.

cosmicduke.about: CosmicDuke, espionage malware linked to APT29.

cryrar.about: Ransomware that locks files in password-protected archives.

danabot.about: DanaBot, modular banking trojan and loader.

darktortilla.about: .NET crypter that hides and launches commodity malware (often AgentTesla, AsyncRAT, Remcos…).

daserf.about: Daserf, backdoor used by the Tick group.

ddosia.about: DDosia, volunteer DDoS client of the NoName057(16) group.

disguisedxmrigminer.about: XMRig miner disguised as another program.

dorifel.about: Dorifel, infector of documents and executables.

downloadguide.about: DownloadGuide, download manager with bundled offers.

droidkungfu.about: DroidKungFu, Android backdoor that roots the device.

duba.about: Chinese security suite installer flagged for bundled offers.

ebury.about: Ebury, OpenSSH backdoor and credential stealer (Linux).

equationdrug.about: EquationDrug, espionage platform of the Equation Group.

exceldna.about: Malicious Excel-DNA (.xll) add-ins used as loaders.

exent.about: Game service installer flagged as PUA.

expiro.about: Expiro, file infector that also steals data.

fakecalls.about: FakeCalls, Android banking trojan that hijacks phone calls.

fakecert.about: Generic name for fake / forged certificates.

fakewallet.about: Fake cryptocurrency wallet apps that steal recovery phrases.

fanny.about: Fanny, USB worm of the Equation Group.

flystudio.about: Programs built with the Chinese E-language (FlyStudio).

funshion.about: Chinese video player installer flagged as adware.

glupteba.about: Glupteba, botnet with miner, proxy and backdoor modules.

gomlab.about: Media player installer flagged for bundled offers.

hiddad.about: HiddAd, Android adware that hides its icon.

hidinstsfx.about: Generic name for silent self-extracting installers.

hudun.about: Chinese software installer flagged for bundled offers.

inmobi.about: Android ad SDK flagged as adware.

kdmapper.about: kdmapper, loads unsigned drivers through a vulnerable driver.

kingsoft.about: Chinese software installer flagged for bundled offers.

kuguo.about: Android ad SDK flagged as adware.

kuwo.about: Chinese music player installer flagged for bundled offers.

ludashi.about: Chinese system tool installer flagged for bundled offers.

lummastealer.about: Lumma Stealer (LummaC2), information stealer sold as a service.

mailru.about: Mail.ru software and toolbars bundled with installers.

mediaget.about: MediaGet torrent client, flagged for bundled offers.

meshagent.about: MeshCentral agent, legitimate remote management (often abused).

nsismod.about: Generic name for modified NSIS installers.

pcappstore.about: App store installer flagged as PUA.

pdfjsc.about: Generic name for PDFs with malicious JavaScript.

pemalform.about: Generic name for malformed PE files.

phorpiex.about: Phorpiex, worm / botnet (spam, sextortion, crypto clipping).

plugx.about: PlugX, RAT used by China-nexus groups.

powerrun.about: PowerRun, runs programs with elevated privileges (dual-use).

prometei.about: Prometei, botnet with a Monero miner.

qihoo360.about: Chinese security suite installer flagged for bundled offers.

qiyi.about: Chinese video software installer flagged for bundled offers.

ramsay.about: Ramsay, espionage framework able to reach air-gapped networks.

rancor.about: Malware of the Rancor espionage group.

redline.about: RedLine Stealer, information stealer sold as a service.

remoteutilities.about: Remote Utilities, legitimate remote access (often abused).

rising.about: Chinese security suite installer flagged for bundled offers.

sality.about: Sality, file infector and P2P botnet.

satana.about: Satana, ransomware that also overwrites the MBR.

shandagames.about: Game publisher installer flagged as PUA.

sharphound.about: SharpHound, Active Directory data collector for BloodHound.

shedun.about: Shedun, Android adware that roots the device.

silentinstallbuilder.about: Installer builder, abused to wrap malware.

softcnapp.about: Chinese app installer flagged as PUA.

spinok.about: SpinOk, Android SDK flagged as adware / spyware.

spyloan.about: SpyLoan, predatory loan apps that harvest phone data.

stantinko.about: Stantinko, botnet for ad fraud and mining.

tacticalrmm.about: Tactical RMM, legitimate remote management (often abused).

tencent.about: Chinese software installer flagged for bundled offers.

utorrent.about: Torrent client installer flagged for bundled offers.

virlock.about: VirLock, ransomware that also infects files.

wacatac.about: Generic detection name used by Microsoft Defender for many unrelated threats — not a real family.

webcompanion.about: Web Companion, browser add-on flagged as PUA.

youmi.about: Android ad SDK flagged as adware.

zylom.about: Game installer flagged for bundled offers.
